north_star: Estimate hidden political and organizational conditions in irregular warfare from incomplete observations, with calibrated uncertainty.

notes: Native scheduler-oracle horizon clipping was aligned with reference exact-continuation semantics.
Research-readiness scoring no longer infers empirical readiness from synthetic data-status wording.

global_particle_weighting.finding: Whole-country likelihood multiplication causes severe particle collapse as observed spatial dimension grows.
global_particle_weighting.example: At 17 localities and 64 particles, effective support fell to roughly 1-3% in the direct-oracle/mixed-proxy diagnostics.

localization.finding: Radius-zero localized marginal weighting removes most of the global dimensionality damage while preserving coherent full-world trajectories.
localization.radius_pilot: Radii 1 and 2 worsened recovery relative to radius 0 on the matched smoke worlds; neighboring evidence is not currently licensed by the observation model.

snapshot_identifiability.interpretation: Dynamics and priors may add identifying restrictions, but full snapshot identification is not available from the current mixed proxy design alone.

channel_ablation_64_particles.interpretation: No single channel explains the weak one-world information gain; single-channel effects are small and the full design remains rank-deficient.

interpretation: This is the first repeated-known-truth pilot showing positive average information gain for localized recovery.
The mixed-proxy and direct-oracle profiles are not a ranking: their channel counts, loadings, reporting probabilities, and noise structures differ.
The normal paired-difference intervals emitted by the runner are descriptive pilot diagnostics, not preregistered confirmatory inference.
Confirmatory world counts, particle counts, severity levels, and promotion gates remain to be frozen before a confirmatory run.
